idea_name: Historical and Monte Carlo portfolio VaR/CVaR risk sensor
mechanism: Historical VaR = percentile of returns × √holding_period; CVaR = mean loss beyond VaR; Monte Carlo VaR draws N(μ,σ) portfolio returns. Used to size positions, set SL from VaR×point, and SLSQP-minimize portfolio VaR subject to target return and Forex leverage/min-position constraints.
data_needed: multi-symbol close returns; weights; confidence_level; holding_period
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, AUDUSD, USDCAD, NZDUSD, EURCHF, EURGBP, AUDCAD; TIMEFRAME_D1 from 2023-01-01

mechanism: trend_adjusted_var: rolling mean trend over lookback (e.g. 20), deviation = returns − trend, VaR = percentile(deviation), output = trend + var. Adapts historical VaR for trend-following systems so risk is measured around local drift not raw zero-mean returns.
why_new_for_mis: Separates local trend from residual risk—useful MIS volatility sensor when regimes have persistent drift.
quote: This feature takes into account the local trend, which is important for trend following systems.

mechanism: adjust_max_drawdown = base_max_drawdown × (recent_volatility / long_term_volatility) over lookback=252; when portfolio_var/account_balance exceeds adjusted max_drawdown, reduce_exposure scales positions down. Tightens risk appetite when short-term vol spikes vs long-term baseline.
data_needed: returns std over recent vs full sample; account_balance; portfolio VaR

mechanism: calculate_var_correlation_matrix: per-pair VaR vector outer-product times returns correlation matrix, yielding VaR-weighted co-risk surface across currency pairs for capital allocation and detecting excessive pair coupling.

idea_name: VaR-based adaptive grid spacing and levels
mechanism: Grid step = base_step × (pair_var / average_var); levels = clamp(base_levels / volatility_factor, 3, 10); entry ladder = price × (1 + i × var) for i in ±levels. Spreads grid wider and thins levels when VaR (vol) rises.
data_needed: per-pair VaR; base grid params; current price
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: multi-currency grid FX; D1 VaR context
why_new_for_mis: Maps a risk sensor directly into spatial trading geometry—vol-conditioned structure useful for MIS regime-aware execution sensing.

mechanism: var_efficiency = |violations − expected_violations| / expected_violations where violations = count(returns < −var) and expected = n×(1−confidence). Quantifies whether the VaR sensor is calibrated; article reports efficiency ≫1 (miscalibration) before strategy adaptations.
why_new_for_mis: Meta-sensor on risk-model quality—MIS can use violation rate as a regime/model-drift flag.
